findings.current: when even the pain began to fade
findings.defect: The source says that a point came when the narrator could no longer feel even the pain, not that the pain itself was fading. This changes the physical mechanism from lost sensation to diminishing pain.
findings.rationale: 고통마저 느껴지지 않을 무렵 describes the pain becoming imperceptible to the narrator, while the current wording states that the pain was subsiding.
findings.replacement: when I could no longer even feel the pain

findings.current: Only once you have realized your folly shall you be permitted to cross into the River of Death.
findings.defect: “Be permitted” adds the implication that the Arch Lich grants permission to enter the River of Death. The source states only that the victim will then be able to head toward it.
findings.rationale: 죽음의 강으로 향할 수 있으리라 expresses ability or eventual possibility, not explicit permission from the Arch Lich.
findings.replacement: Only after you have realized your folly will you be able to make your way to the River of Death.

findings.current: drove the darkness from every joint
findings.defect: The current wording loses the source's image of darkness engraved into the bone joints. It reduces a specific visual and physical detail to darkness merely located at the joints.
findings.rationale: 뼈마디에 새겨진 어둠 explicitly describes darkness etched into the joints, an image preserved by the accepted baseline.
findings.replacement: drove away the darkness engraved in each joint

summary: The chapter is largely faithful, but three minor wording choices alter specific source details or implications.
